status: Pre-registered before this workspace computes any model metric. Researcher has seen public current-season scores; this is not a claim of a pristine human-blinded holdout.

scope.current_cutoff: 2026 regular-season week 8; only games whose official embedded summary phase is FINAL or FINAL_OVERTIME at retrieval
scope.warmup: 2024 regular season and earlier games within the evaluation window are used only as prior information
scope.evaluation: Expanding weekly out-of-sample evaluation beginning 2025 week 1; every prediction is frozen before that week's outcomes enter the rating/history state
exclusions: market prices without an operator timestamp and settlement rule

official_data_policy.facts: Only values explicitly present in an official NFL response are transcribed. Missing values remain null/blank and are flagged.
official_data_policy.derived: Probabilities, fair lines, correlations and test statistics are computed outputs, never described as official NFL publications or sportsbook offers.
official_data_policy.snapshots: Acquisition records URL, retrieval time, HTTP status and SHA-256. Full expressive HTML is not intended for public redistribution; the release keeps factual extractions and hashes under a rights review flag.

models.name: Constant baseline
models.rule: p(home win among non-ties)=0.5; tie probability is the expanding prior tie rate with one pseudo-tie in 100 pseudo-games

models.name: Margin-adjusted Elo
models.rule: Expected home score uses (home_rating + home_advantage - away_rating)/400 in a base-10 logistic. Update after each final game using margin multiplier ln(1+abs(margin))/ln(18), clipped to [0.5,2.0]. Regress team ratings 25% toward 1500 at season boundary.
models.tuning: fixed before evaluation; no holdout search

models.name: Elo plus rest logistic
models.rule: Ridge logistic regression on [1, Elo rating difference/100, rest-day difference/3], fitted only on prior final non-tie games with L2=10. Before 80 prior observations use M01. Rest is capped to [-10,10] days; first game of a team's season has rest null and uses league-median prior rest only if at least 20 prior rest observations exist, otherwise zero.

models.name: Scoring environment
models.rule: Expected team points are the average of its prior points-for and opponent prior points-against, shrunk to the prior league team-game mean with four pseudo-games. Margin forecast is (home_rating+45-away_rating)/25. Fair half-point lines add the median prior residual and round to the nearest half-point away from an integer. Cover/over probabilities use the prior empirical residual distribution.

strategies.name: Calibrated favorite moneyline
strategies.selection: Only if a verified operator price implies an after-cost edge whose dependence-aware lower confidence bound is positive
strategies.status: blocked: no verified operator price archive

strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted spread
strategies.selection: Compare own half-point spread with a verified operator line; require price, push/void rules and edge gates
strategies.status: blocked: no verified operator price archive

strategies.name: Scoring-environment total
strategies.selection: Compare own total with a verified operator total; require weather/availability timestamp and edge gates
strategies.status: blocked: no verified operator price archive

strategies.name: Two-game winner parlay
strategies.selection: Choose the two highest calibrated edges only after weekly dependence and operator combo price are verified
strategies.status: blocked: no combo prices or prospective ticket sample

strategies.name: Two-game total parlay
strategies.selection: Use week-clustered joint scenarios; never assume independent legs solely because games differ
strategies.status: blocked: no combo prices or prospective ticket sample

strategies.name: Receptions plus receiving yards
strategies.selection: Same-player joint distribution from official logs; require availability, operator thresholds, combo price and settlement terms
strategies.status: blocked: selected-panel sample below gate and no operator prices

strategies.name: Passing yards plus passing touchdowns
strategies.selection: Same-player joint distribution from official logs; no independence multiplication
strategies.status: blocked: selected-panel sample below gate and no operator prices

strategies.name: Player volume plus team win
strategies.selection: Condition player volume on game state and team win; require verified same-game combo price
strategies.status: blocked: no verified combo prices or validated joint model

gates.name: Source and integrity
gates.rule: Every factual row has an official source URL; snapshot hashes match; game IDs unique; quarter scores sum to totals; no future outcome enters a prediction
gates.threshold: 100% of published factual rows; zero integrity failures

gates.name: Sample size
gates.threshold: singles >=300 games; player props >=1000 player-games; combos >=200 settled tickets

gates.name: Skill versus baseline
gates.rule: Lower Brier and log loss than baseline; paired week-cluster bootstrap 95% CI of Brier improvement excludes zero; BH-FDR across registered model comparisons

gates.name: Calibration
gates.rule: Five equal-count probability bins on out-of-sample predictions; report observed frequency and Wilson interval
gates.threshold: expected calibration error <=0.03 and no bin absolute gap >0.10

gates.name: Verified price and edge
gates.rule: Timestamped operator offer, de-vig method, settlement/void/push rules, limits and slippage recorded
gates.threshold: after-cost expected ROI lower 95% dependence-aware bound >0 and point estimate >=2%

gates.name: Dependence and combo pricing
gates.rule: Joint probabilities calibrated; compare with independence product using game/week-clustered uncertainty
gates.threshold: joint model beats independence product under G03; no unpriced correlation assumption

gates.name: Leakage and placebo controls
gates.rule: Future-feature perturbation must change predictions; within-week outcome permutation null must not reproduce the observed skill gain
gates.threshold: zero leakage-test failures; observed improvement above 95th percentile of 1000 placebo replicates

gates.name: Robustness
gates.rule: Rolling block stability and concentration checks
gates.threshold: positive Brier improvement in >=60% of season-week blocks; no single week contributes >25% of total improvement

gates.name: Execution and settlement
gates.rule: Operator-specific acceptance, void, push, dead-heat, inactive-player and payout-cap rules archived; paper ledger reconciled
gates.threshold: 100% rule coverage; zero unresolved settlement mismatches

gates.name: Prospective replication
gates.rule: Lock code, parameters and selection before future events; no post-hoc exclusions
gates.threshold: >=100 future settled observations/tickets and repeat pass of applicable gates

statistics: paired joint hit rate where applicable
correlation_policy.uncertainty: 2000 bootstrap replicates; resample whole games for same-game pairs and whole season-weeks for cross-game pairs; percentile 95% intervals; BH-FDR within the registered family
correlation_policy.interpretation: Correlation is association, not causation or betting edge. Zero correlation does not establish independence. Player panel is selected from current official leaders and is descriptive, not a population-wide prop validation.

player_panel.plus: official skill leaders in the next scheduled game if not already included
player_panel.selection_source: NFL.com 2026 regular-season category tables at retrieval

leaderboard.ranking: Eligible entries ranked by out-of-sample log loss, then Brier improvement versus baseline, then lower maximum drawdown. Forecast-only research ranking is shown separately and is not reward eligibility.
leaderboard.rewards: Non-monetary badges only until every applicable gate passes and an operator-independent reward policy is published. No funded prize pool, wager placement, or promised return.
leaderboard.anti_luck: No reward for raw hit rate or short-run ROI; frozen protocol, dependence-aware intervals, multiplicity control, placebo tests and prospective replication are required.

responsible_use: Research only; not wagering advice. Luck cannot be eliminated. No strategy is validated for betting in this release.
